newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen mixed, investors await budget.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen mixed, investors await budget.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are expected to remain mixed ahead of next month's revenue budget for fiscal 1997/98 (July-June), brokers said.

"The market may have a mixed trend with both buying and selling. This trend may continue until the announcement of the budget," said broker Mohammad Ullah. However, brokers said the share prices might fall slightly amid a market correction that began on Monday. Brokers said the prices, which rose over the past week, were expected to fall across the board. The DSE benchmark index fell 14.42 points or 1.17 percent at 1,213.88 on Monday. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
